note: R09 Genesis 44 created monsters: I1-I3 chase/contact only; silver cup accuser and chain projectile. PPU32, binary alpha, one-pixel margin. Actor parent flip once. Projectile is right facing and rotated once from actual Core direction around centre pivot. No debuff, blocking or extra damage. Warning is three real Core projected directions, never a slam ring.
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per clip; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the actor's parent (or its single renderer), same rule as art 03 / R02-R05

alphaPolicies.binary: alpha is 0 or 255 only; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0

edgeMargin.why: no opaque pixel in the outer 1 px ring of a frame, so Point filtering and flipX never cut the outline; ground sprites stand on the foot row = cell.h - 1 - pivot.y (30 for 32 px, 62 for 64 px)

catalog.bossAttack: three_way_chain_projectiles: cycle5s, windup1s, 3 directions base +/-20deg, speed1.35wu/s, radius.16wu, lifetime6s, damage15; technical initial values only

r03.why: reuse existing boss shadow only; R09 attacks are not R03 slam rings
